name: React-Portfolio
description: Portfolio built using react and tailwind

paragraphs: The personal portfolio, blog and admin dashboard of Suryanshu Verma
A React single-page app that renders a fully CMS-driven portfolio and ships its own admin dashboard, so every section of the site can be edited live without touching code.
All content is fetched from the Portfolio Backend API. Authentication uses httpOnly cookies, so no tokens are ever stored in the browser.
features: Public portfolio — hero, about, experience, skills, services, projects with full case-study pages, certificates, live coding activity, a blog and a contact form.
Admin dashboard (/dashboard) — a CMS for every one of those sections, plus analytics, a message inbox, comment moderation, user management, passkey security and site-wide settings.
🎨 Light / dark theme — follows the OS preference, remembers the user's choice, and is applied before first paint (no flash).
⚡ Animated UI — Framer Motion page transitions, typewriter hero, initial loader and skeleton states.
🗂 Projects — featured and regular project cards, image galleries, and dedicated case-study pages (/projects/:slug) with architecture diagrams, features, challenges, learnings and evaluation metrics.

requirements.text: 🚧 Maintenance mode — the admin can take the public pages offline with one toggle, while login and the dashboard stay reachable.
🔐 Passkeys (WebAuthn) — passwordless sign-up and login, plus "add this device" linking via an emailed one-time link
